```typescript
import { STORAGE_KEYS } from "../app_constants";
import { acquireClientId } from "../collab/clientIdentity";

/**
 * Minimal Web Locks stand-in: one shared lock table (the browser profile),
 * one LockManager per simulated tab. Closing a tab releases its locks, like
 * the browser does.
 */
const createBrowser = () => {
  const held = new Map<string, symbol>();

  const openTab = () => {
    const tab = Symbol("tab");

    const locks = {
      request: async (
        name: string,
        optionsOrCallback: LockOptions | LockGrantedCallback,
        maybeCallback?: LockGrantedCallback,
      ) => {
        const [options, callback] =
          typeof optionsOrCallback === "function"
            ? [{} as LockOptions, optionsOrCallback]
            : [optionsOrCallback, maybeCallback!];

        if (held.has(name)) {
          if (options.ifAvailable) {
            return callback(null);
          }
          throw new Error(`test lock "${name}" contended`);
        }

        held.set(name, tab);
        const result = callback({ name, mode: "exclusive" } as Lock);
        // released when the callback settles; a never-settling callback holds
        // the lock until the tab closes
        Promise.resolve(result).finally(() => {
          if (held.get(name) === tab) {
            held.delete(name);
          }
        });
        return result;
      },
    } as unknown as LockManager;

    const close = () => {
      for (const [name, owner] of held) {
        if (owner === tab) {
          held.delete(name);
        }
      }
    };

    return { locks, close };
  };

  return { openTab };
};

// each simulated tab has its own sessionStorage; localStorage is shared
const switchToFreshTabSession = () => sessionStorage.clear();

describe("acquireClientId", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    sessionStorage.clear();
  });

  it("gives a new tab a new id and remembers it in the profile's pool", async () => {
    const tab = createBrowser().openTab();

    const id = await acquireClientId(tab.locks);

    expect(id).toBeTruthy();
    expect(
      JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_CLIENT_IDS)!),
    ).toEqual([id]);
    expect(sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SESSION_STORAGE_CLIENT_ID)).toBe(
      id,
    );
  });

  it("gives concurrently open tabs different ids", async () => {
    const browser = createBrowser();

    const id1 = await acquireClientId(browser.openTab().locks);
    switchToFreshTabSession();
    const id2 = await acquireClientId(browser.openTab().locks);

    expect(id2).not.toBe(id1);
  });

  it("lets a new tab reclaim a closed tab's id", async () => {
    const browser = createBrowser();

    const tab1 = browser.openTab();
    const id1 = await acquireClientId(tab1.locks);
    tab1.close();

    switchToFreshTabSession();
    const id2 = await acquireClientId(browser.openTab().locks);

    expect(id2).toBe(id1);
  });

  it("keeps the id across a reload (same tab session)", async () => {
    const browser = createBrowser();

    const beforeReload = browser.openTab();
    const id1 = await acquireClientId(beforeReload.locks);
    beforeReload.close(); // reload releases the page's locks

    const afterReload = browser.openTab(); // sessionStorage kept
    expect(await acquireClientId(afterReload.locks)).toBe(id1);
  });

  it("gives a duplicated tab (copied sessionStorage) its own id", async () => {
    const browser = createBrowser();

    const id1 = await acquireClientId(browser.openTab().locks);
    // duplicate: same sessionStorage contents, original tab still open
    const id2 = await acquireClientId(browser.openTab().locks);

    expect(id2).not.toBe(id1);
  });

  it("falls back to a per-tab sessionStorage id without Web Locks", async () => {
    const id1 = await acquireClientId(undefined);
    expect(await acquireClientId(undefined)).toBe(id1);

    switchToFreshTabSession();
    expect(await acquireClientId(undefined)).not.toBe(id1);
  });
});
```

```text
  const { points, fixedSegments, fileId } = updates as any;

    (Object.keys(updates).length === 0 || // normalization case

        options,
      ),

  } else if (typeof points !== "undefined") {
    updates = { ...getSizeFromPoints(points), ...updates };
  }

  for (const key in updates) {
    const value = (updates as any)[key];
    if (typeof value !== "undefined") {
      if (
        (element as any)[key] === value &&
        // if object, always update because its attrs could have changed
        // (except for specific keys we handle below)
        (typeof value !== "object" ||
          value === null ||
          key === "groupIds" ||
          key === "scale")
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      if (key === "scale") {
        const prevScale = (element as any)[key];
        const nextScale = value;
        if (prevScale[0] === nextScale[0] && prevScale[1] === nextScale[1]) {
          continue;
        }
      } else if (key === "points") {
        const prevPoints = (element as any)[key];
        const nextPoints = value;
        if (prevPoints.length === nextPoints.length) {
          let didChangePoints = false;
          let index = prevPoints.length;
          while (--index) {
            const prevPoint = prevPoints[index];
            const nextPoint = nextPoints[index];
            if (
              prevPoint[0] !== nextPoint[0] ||
              prevPoint[1] !== nextPoint[1]
            ) {
              didChangePoints = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (!didChangePoints) {
            continue;
          }
        }
      }

      (element as any)[key] = value;
      didChange = true;
    }
  }

  if (!didChange) {
    return element;
  }

  if (
    typeof updates.height !== "undefined" ||
    typeof updates.width !== "undefined" ||
    typeof fileId != "undefined" ||
    typeof points !== "undefined"
  ) {
    ShapeCache.delete(element);
  }

  element.version = updates.version ?? element.version + 1;
  element.versionNonce = updates.versionNonce ?? randomInteger();
```

## Step 3 done: client identity, `USER_IDENTITY` and automatic stamping

The typecheck and lint pass, and the full suite passes: 127 files, 1,873 tests, with 13 new tests and no new snapshot changes.

**This is the first step that works across clients**: drawings are now stamped automatically with whoever created them, and other clients learn each tab's name and ID **as soon as it joins**. That fixes the "names only appear after the mouse moves" problem you hit earlier.

### How it works

```
 TAB OPENS A ROOM ─► Collab.startCollaboration
   │  clientId = await getClientId()          clientIdentity.ts (pool + Web Locks + sessionStorage)
   │  remoteElementIds = new Set()
   ├─ NEW room:   stamp all of my existing elements ─► first Firebase save already stamped
   └─ JOIN room:  initializeRoom ─► loadFromFirebase ─► markRemoteElements(all)   (scene was reset)
                  socketInitialized = true ─► broadcastUserIdentity()   ◄── "I'm here: id + name"

 PEER JOINS ─► Portal "new-user" ─► send INIT scene + broadcastUserIdentity()   ◄── "here's who I am"

 INCOMING ELEMENTS (INIT / UPDATE / Firebase echo) ─► _reconcileElements
   └─ markRemoteElements: ids NOT already in my scene ─► remoteElementIds
      (my own elements are always already in my scene, so echoes never mark them remote)

 LOCAL CHANGE ─► onChange ─► Collab.syncElements
   ├─ if socketInitialized: stampLocallyCreatedElements
   │     getElementsToStamp = not deleted ∧ not remote ∧ creatorId ≠ me      creatorStamp.ts
   │     excalidrawAPI.mutateElement(el, {customData:{…, creatorId: me}}, false)
   │        in place (safe mid-drawing), version++ so the stamp syncs
   └─ broadcastElements ─► peers receive the stamp like any other element change

 INCOMING IDENTITY ─► USER_IDENTITY / MOUSE_LOCATION / IDLE_STATUS ─► updateCollaborator(socketId, { id: clientId, username })
 MY OWN ENTRY ─► setCollaborators ─► { isCurrentUser: true, id: myClientId }   (step 5 uses this for "You")
```

### The ownership rule, as built

An element is stamped as yours **only if it first appeared in your tab**: you drew it, pasted it or duplicated it.

- **Editing someone else's shape** never changes its owner, because its ID is in `remoteElementIds`.
- **Pasting or duplicating** creates a new ID. That copy isn't remote, so it gets **your** stamp, replacing the copied one.
- **Older, unstamped room content** stays unstamped and goes to Miscellaneous.
- **Self-healing:** if undo or redo ever restores one of your elements without its stamp, the next sync stamps it again. The rule is "not remote and not already mine", so applying it again never does harm.

### Files changed in step 3

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| [collab/clientIdentity.ts](excalidraw-app/collab/clientIdentity.ts) **NEW** | The per-tab ID pool: tries the `sessionStorage` ID first, then free IDs from the pool, then creates a new one. Web Locks are held for the tab's lifetime, the pool is capped at 32, and browsers without Web Locks fall back to `sessionStorage` |
| [collab/creatorStamp.ts](excalidraw-app/collab/creatorStamp.ts) **NEW** | The pure rule: `getElementsToStamp()` and `getStampedCustomData()` (which keeps any other `customData` keys) |
| [collab/Collab.tsx](excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx) | Holds `clientId` and `remoteElementIds`. Contains `markRemoteElements` and `stampLocallyCreatedElements`, the hooks in `startCollaboration`, `initializeRoom`, `_reconcileElements` and `syncElements`, the `USER_IDENTITY` case, `clientId` → `Collaborator.id`, your own entry's ID, a re-announcement on rename, and a reset when you leave |
| [collab/Portal.tsx](excalidraw-app/collab/Portal.tsx) | `broadcastUserIdentity()` (non-volatile), called on `new-user`. Adds `clientId` to `MOUSE_LOCATION` and `IDLE_STATUS` |
| [data/index.ts](excalidraw-app/data/index.ts) | The `USER_IDENTITY` payload type, and an **optional** `clientId` on the mouse and idle payloads, since older clients won't send it |
| [app_constants.ts](excalidraw-app/app_constants.ts) | `WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY`, plus the two storage keys |
| [tests/creatorStamp.test.ts](excalidraw-app/tests/creatorStamp.test.ts) **NEW** | 6 tests: new elements, remote elements, legacy elements, a pasted foreign stamp, already mine, deleted, and keeping other `customData` |
| [tests/clientIdentity.test.ts](excalidraw-app/tests/clientIdentity.test.ts) **NEW** | 6 tests using a **fake Web Locks browser** to simulate tabs: a new tab, two tabs at once, reclaiming a closed tab's ID, a reload, a duplicated tab, and the fallback without locks |
| [tests/collab.test.tsx](excalidraw-app/tests/collab.test.tsx) | 1 integration test through the **real Collab class**: a new room stamps your existing and pasted shapes, and their versions are bumped so the stamp syncs |

**A test-isolation catch:** at first, my Collab test failed only when run together with the existing tests. The cause was that the existing test's `startCollaboration()` puts a room link in jsdom's URL, which **persists between tests**, so the next render joined that room automatically. My test now resets the URL first. No production code was involved.

**Compatibility with older clients:** I checked that unknown message types reach `assertNever(…, null)`, which returns silently. Clients running older code ignore `USER_IDENTITY`, and the extra `clientId` fields are optional.

### Checking it yourself: multiple clients

Restart `yarn start` if it's running. The room server needs nothing new. Use **Brave profile 1, Brave profile 2 and Edge**, plus a **second tab in Brave profile 1**. In each client's console:

```js
const me = () => window.collab.getClientId();
const people = () =>
  console.table(
    [...h.state.collaborators.values()].map((c) => ({
      name: c.username,
      id: c.id,
      you: !!c.isCurrentUser,
    })),
  );
const owners = () =>
  console.table(
    h.elements
      .filter((e) => !e.isDeleted)
      .map((e) => ({
        id: e.id,
        type: e.type,
        creatorId: e.customData?.creatorId ?? "(none)",
      })),
  );
const hide = (...ids) => h.setState({ hiddenCollaboratorIds: new Set(ids) });
```

| Check | Expected |
| --- | --- |
| A creates a room, and B joins **without moving the mouse** | On A, `people()` already shows B's name and ID. The old delay is gone |
| A draws a shape, then everyone runs `owners()` | Every client shows the same `creatorId`, equal to A's `me()` |
| B moves or recolours A's shape | `creatorId` is still A's |
| B copies A's shape and pastes it | The copy's `creatorId` is B's |
| Two tabs in the same Brave profile | Different `me()` values, and both appear in `people()` |
| Close tab 2, then open a new tab and join the room | It gets tab 2's old `me()` back. `localStorage["excalidraw-client-ids"]` lists the IDs in the pool |
| Reload any tab | `me()` is unchanged |
| On A, run `hide("<B's id>")` | B's drawings disappear on A **only**. Steps 1 to 2.5 now run on real stamps |
| A room drawn in before this change | Those shapes show `creatorId: (none)`, the Miscellaneous bucket |

### Known limitations

- **Stamping waits until the room has loaded.** A shape drawn in the first moment after joining gets stamped on the next sync, which is very quick, and attribution stays correct.
- **Unstamped shapes before a reload stay unknown.** If a tab reloads while one of its shapes still hasn't been stamped (very unlikely), the room reload marks that shape as remote, so it stays Unknown. Already-stamped shapes are unaffected.
- **The Excalidraw+ and shareable-link exports** don't carry identity. That's intended, since those are static snapshots.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-21 01:46:40Z)**_

That console error **isn't caused by this feature**, and it's harmless. It's a developer-only warning from upstream Excalidraw.

## What the error means

The stack you pasted, read from the bottom up:

```
Collab.tsx:1067  queueSaveToFirebase        (throttled: runs ~every 20 s)
Collab.tsx:330   saveCollabRoomToFirebase
firebase.ts:222  reconcileElements(local, stored)
reconcile.ts:112 validateIndicesThrottled   ← only when isDevEnv()
fractionalIndex.ts:86  "includeBoundTextValidation"
textElement.ts:310     console.error("[NONDELETED][INVARIANT] …")
```

- **It only runs in dev mode.** `validateIndicesThrottled` checks `isDevEnv() || isTestEnv()`. In a production build this code never runs, so real users can't see the message.
- **It checks deleted elements too.** It goes through every element in the room, including deleted ones, which Firebase keeps for 24 hours. For each shape that has a label, it looks up the label. If you've **deleted a shape that had text in it**, both the shape and its label are `isDeleted: true`, and the lookup logs this warning.

## Why it seemed random

The warning doesn't show up when you take the action. It shows up at the **next throttled Firebase save, up to about 20 seconds later**. So whatever you did just before it appeared, such as a paste, looks like the cause. The real triggers are things that delete a labeled shape: Delete, **Cut (Ctrl+X)**, the eraser, or undoing the creation of a labeled shape.

## How I checked it isn't from our changes

1. **The files involved are untouched.** `git diff` shows no changes to `textElement.ts`, `fractionalIndex.ts`, `reconcile.ts` or `firebase.ts`.
2. **It reproduces without the feature.** A throwaway test (deleted afterwards) passed one deleted rectangle and its deleted label straight to `validateFractionalIndices`, and it logged exactly this message. No creator stamps or visibility code were involved.
3. **It comes from upstream code.**

   - The validator: Marcel Mraz, upstream PR #8235 "ability to debug the state of fractional indices", 2024-07-30.
   - The error message: Augusto Xavier, upstream PR #11470 "narrow `NonDeleted` type to `isDeleted: false`", 2026-07-07.

   Neither author is on your team.

If you want to be fully sure, run a room on `master` (without this branch), delete a shape that has text in it, and wait about 20 seconds. You should see the same message.

## Labels on another person's shape

What you saw is the agreed design. A label follows **its shape's** owner, even though the label itself carries the stamp of whoever typed it. It's handled in one place, `getElementCreatorId` in [ownership.ts](packages/element/src/ownership.ts), so it's easy to change if your team ever wants labels to follow their own author instead.

No code changed in this reply. Type **"Approved"** to continue to step 4: the per-room **Previously seen** list.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-21 01:49:01Z)**_

Starting step 4: the **Previously seen** directory. It's the data the dropdown in steps 5 and 6 will display. One design point first, because it affects code that's already written.

**"Never seen" creators need to land in Miscellaneous.** A shape can be stamped by someone this client never saw (for example, they left before you joined). Its `creatorId` is real, but you can't name it, so it belongs in the same bucket as unstamped content. And if that person shows up later, their shapes should **move to their own row, visible**.

That means the hidden-element rule needs one extra input, the directory. The check becomes: hidden if `creatorId ∈ hidden`, or if Miscellaneous is hidden **and** this creator isn't in the directory. While there's **no directory at all** (solo mode, or your console tests), every creator keeps its own bucket, so your `hide("test")` debugging still works.

```typescript
/**
 * Per-room directory of collaborators this browser has seen ("Previously
 * seen"), so their drawings stay attributable — and individually toggleable —
 * after they leave, including across tab close/reopen.
 *
 * Stored locally only (room id → client id → name + last seen). Room keys are
 * never stored, so this can't be used to open a room.
 */

import { STORAGE_KEYS } from "../app_constants";

import type { CollaboratorDirectoryEntry } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/types";

export type CollaboratorDirectory = Map<string, CollaboratorDirectoryEntry>;

/** keep the most recently used rooms only */
const MAX_ROOMS = 20;
/** keep the most recently seen collaborators per room only */
const MAX_ENTRIES_PER_ROOM = 200;
/**
 * how stale `lastSeen` may get before a sighting is worth recording again
 * (pointer updates arrive ~30×/s, we don't want to write on each)
 */
export const SIGHTING_REFRESH_MS = 60 * 1000;

type StoredRooms = Record<
  string,
  { updated: number; entries: Record<string, CollaboratorDirectoryEntry> }
>;

const isEntry = (value: any): value is CollaboratorDirectoryEntry =>
  !!value &&
  typeof value === "object" &&
  (value.username === null || typeof value.username === "string") &&
  typeof value.lastSeen === "number";

const readRooms = (): StoredRooms => {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_COLLABORATOR_DIRECTORY) ||
        "{}",
    );
    return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)
      ? parsed
      : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
};

export const loadCollaboratorDirectory = (
  roomId: string,
): CollaboratorDirectory => {
  const directory: CollaboratorDirectory = new Map();
  const entries = readRooms()[roomId]?.entries;
  if (entries && typeof entries === "object") {
    for (const [clientId, entry] of Object.entries(entries)) {
      if (clientId && isEntry(entry)) {
        directory.set(clientId, {
          username: entry.username,
          lastSeen: entry.lastSeen,
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return directory;
};

export const saveCollaboratorDirectory = (
  roomId: string,
  directory: ReadonlyMap<string, CollaboratorDirectoryEntry>,
) => {
  const rooms = readRooms();

  rooms[roomId] = {
    updated: Date.now(),
    entries: Object.fromEntries(
      [...directory]
        .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b.lastSeen - a.lastSeen)
        .slice(0, MAX_ENTRIES_PER_ROOM),
    ),
  };

  const recentRooms = Object.entries(rooms)
    .sort(([, a], [, b]) => (b?.updated ?? 0) - (a?.updated ?? 0))
    .slice(0, MAX_ROOMS);

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(
      STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_COLLABORATOR_DIRECTORY,
      JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(recentRooms)),
    );
  } catch {
    // storage unavailable — directory stays in memory for this session
  }
};

/**
 * Records that `clientId` was seen. Returns the updated directory, or `null`
 * when nothing changed enough to be worth publishing/saving.
 *
 * @param username `undefined` = not part of this update (keep the known one)
 */
export const recordCollaboratorSighting = (
  directory: ReadonlyMap<string, CollaboratorDirectoryEntry>,
  clientId: string,
  username: string | null | undefined,
  now = Date.now(),
): CollaboratorDirectory | null => {
  const prev = directory.get(clientId);
  const nextUsername =
    username === undefined ? prev?.username ?? null : username || null;

  if (
    prev &&
    prev.username === nextUsername &&
    now - prev.lastSeen < SIGHTING_REFRESH_MS
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const next = new Map(directory);
  next.set(clientId, { username: nextUsername, lastSeen: now });
  return next;
};
```

```text
export const restoreAppState = (
  appState: ImportedDataState["appState"],
  localAppState: Partial<AppState> | null | undefined,
): RestoredAppState => {
  appState = appState || {};
  const defaultAppState = getDefaultAppState();
  const nextAppState = {} as typeof defaultAppState;

  // first, migrate all legacy AppState properties to new ones. We do it
  // in one go before migrate the rest of the properties in case the new ones
  // depend on checking any other key (i.e. they are coupled)
  for (const legacyKey of Object.keys(
    LegacyAppStateMigrations,
  ) as (keyof typeof LegacyAppStateMigrations)[]) {
    if (legacyKey in appState) {
      const [nextKey, nextValue] = LegacyAppStateMigrations[legacyKey](
        appState,
        defaultAppState,
      );
      (nextAppState as any)[nextKey] = nextValue;
    }
  }

  for (const [key, defaultValue] of Object.entries(defaultAppState) as [
    keyof typeof defaultAppState,
    any,
  ][]) {
    // if AppState contains a legacy key, prefer that one and migrate its
    // value to the new one
    const suppliedValue = appState[key];

    const localValue = localAppState ? localAppState[key] : undefined;
    (nextAppState as any)[key] =
      suppliedValue !== undefined
        ? suppliedValue
        : localValue !== undefined
        ? localValue
        : defaultValue;
  }

  const boxSelectionMode =
    appState.boxSelectionMode ?? localAppState?.boxSelectionMode;
  if (boxSelectionMode !== undefined) {
    nextAppState.boxSelectionMode = boxSelectionMode;
  }
```

```text
  setCollaborators(sockets: SocketId[]) {
    const collaborators: InstanceType<typeof Collab>["collaborators"] =
      new Map();
    for (const socketId of sockets) {
      const isCurrentUser = socketId === this.portal.socket?.id;
      collaborators.set(
        socketId,
        Object.assign(
          {},
          this.collaborators.get(socketId),
          { isCurrentUser },
          // lets the editor tell which creator id is "you"
          isCurrentUser && this.clientId ? { id: this.clientId } : {},
        ),
      );
    }
    this.collaborators = collaborators;
    this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({ collaborators });
  }

  updateCollaborator = (socketId: SocketId, updates: Partial<Collaborator>) => {
    const collaborators = new Map(this.collaborators);
    const user: Mutable<Collaborator> = Object.assign(
      {},
      collaborators.get(socketId),
      updates,
      {
        isCurrentUser: socketId === this.portal.socket?.id,
      },
    );
    collaborators.set(socketId, user);
    this.collaborators = collaborators;

    this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
      collaborators,
    });
  };

  public setLastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion = (version: number) => {
    this.lastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion = version;
  };
```

```typescript
import { STORAGE_KEYS } from "../app_constants";
import {
  SIGHTING_REFRESH_MS,
  loadCollaboratorDirectory,
  recordCollaboratorSighting,
  saveCollaboratorDirectory,
} from "../collab/collaboratorDirectory";

const NOW = 1_000_000;

describe("collaborator directory storage", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
  });

  it("round-trips per room", () => {
    saveCollaboratorDirectory(
      "room-a",
      new Map([["alice", { username: "Alice", lastSeen: NOW }]]),
    );
    saveCollaboratorDirectory(
      "room-b",
      new Map([["bob", { username: "Bob", lastSeen: NOW }]]),
    );

    expect([...loadCollaboratorDirectory("room-a")]).toEqual([
      ["alice", { username: "Alice", lastSeen: NOW }],
    ]);
    expect([...loadCollaboratorDirectory("room-b").keys()]).toEqual(["bob"]);
    expect(loadCollaboratorDirectory("unknown-room").size).toBe(0);
  });

  it("ignores malformed storage instead of throwing", () => {
    localStorage.setItem(
      STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_COLLABORATOR_DIRECTORY,
      "not json",
    );
    expect(loadCollaboratorDirectory("room-a").size).toBe(0);

    localStorage.setItem(
      STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_COLLABORATOR_DIRECTORY,
      JSON.stringify({
        "room-a": {
          updated: NOW,
          entries: {
            valid: { username: null, lastSeen: NOW },
            invalid: { username: 42 },
          },
        },
      }),
    );
    expect([...loadCollaboratorDirectory("room-a").keys()]).toEqual(["valid"]);
  });

  it("keeps only the 20 most recently used rooms", () => {
    for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
      saveCollaboratorDirectory(`room-${i}`, new Map());
    }
    const stored = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_COLLABORATOR_DIRECTORY)!,
    );
    expect(Object.keys(stored).length).toBe(20);
    // the room saved last is always kept
    expect(stored).toHaveProperty("room-24");
  });
});

describe("recordCollaboratorSighting", () => {
  const known = new Map([["alice", { username: "Alice", lastSeen: NOW }]]);

  it("adds new collaborators", () => {
    const next = recordCollaboratorSighting(known, "bob", "Bob", NOW);
    expect(next?.get("bob")).toEqual({ username: "Bob", lastSeen: NOW });
    // doesn't mutate the previous directory
    expect(known.has("bob")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("returns null for repeated sightings (no write per pointer move)", () => {
    expect(recordCollaboratorSighting(known, "alice", "Alice", NOW + 1)).toBe(
      null,
    );
  });

  it("updates the name when it changes", () => {
    const next = recordCollaboratorSighting(known, "alice", "Alicia", NOW + 1);
    expect(next?.get("alice")?.username).toBe("Alicia");
  });

  it("keeps the known name when an update has none", () => {
    expect(recordCollaboratorSighting(known, "alice", "", NOW + 1)).toBe(null);
    const stale = recordCollaboratorSighting(
      known,
      "alice",
      undefined,
      NOW + SIGHTING_REFRESH_MS,
    );
    expect(stale?.get("alice")?.username).toBe("Alice");
  });

  it("refreshes lastSeen once it's stale", () => {
    const later = NOW + SIGHTING_REFRESH_MS;
    expect(
      recordCollaboratorSighting(known, "alice", "Alice", later)?.get("alice"),
    ).toEqual({ username: "Alice", lastSeen: later });
  });
});
```

The typecheck and lint pass. The full suite passes **without updating snapshots**: 128 files, 1,889 tests, with 16 new tests.

The data behind the dropdown's three sections now exists: **In the room** (live collaborators), **Previously seen** (the saved directory) and **Miscellaneous** (unknown buckets). The buttons that use it come next, in step 5.

### What it does

```
 excalidraw-app (Collab)                                   editor (library)

 startCollaboration(roomId)
   load localStorage["excalidraw-collaborator-directory"][roomId]
   record myself ─────────────────────────────────────────► appState.collaboratorDirectory
   hiddenCollaboratorIds = ∅  (fresh per room)               (Map clientId → {username, lastSeen})

```

A creator this client has **never seen** shares Miscellaneous with unstamped content. **As soon as they're seen, their drawings move to their own bucket**, visible unless that bucket is hidden. ## The first bug fix (room pruning)

### What the code was supposed to do

The directory stores at most **20 rooms**. Every time a room is saved, the most recently used rooms are kept and the rest are dropped. The room you're in **must always survive**, because you're saving it right now.

### The old code

```ts
const rooms = readRooms();
rooms[roomId] = { updated: Date.now(), entries: … };      // ① write the current room

const recentRooms = Object.entries(rooms)
  .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b.updated - a.updated)          // ② newest first
  .slice(0, MAX_ROOMS);                                   // ③ keep 20
```

This relies on one assumption: that the current room's `updated` value is **strictly larger** than every other room's. When that isn't true, ordering falls back on something else:

- **JavaScript's sort is stable.** When two rooms have the same `updated` value, they keep their original order.
- **That original order comes from `Object.entries`**, which lists keys in the order they were **added** to the object.
- **A room you've never saved before is added last**, so it comes **at the end** of the list.

So if the current room ties with the others on `updated`, it sorts to the end, and `.slice(0, 20)` **cuts off the room you just saved**.

### How the test caught it

```ts
for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) saveCollaboratorDirectory(`room-${i}`, new Map());
expect(stored).toHaveProperty("room-24"); // the last room saved must survive
```

The loop runs in under a millisecond, so all 25 rooms get **the same** `Date.now()` value. Rooms 0 to 19 kept their places, and `room-24`, the one just saved, was dropped. The test passed on the first run only because the loop happened to cross a millisecond boundary. After that it failed every time.

### Would it happen for real users?

A same-millisecond tie is unlikely in normal use, but there's a realistic version: **the computer's clock moving backwards**, for example after a time-zone or daylight-saving change or a sync correction. In that case the current room's `updated` is **older** than rooms saved before the change. If you'd used 20 or more rooms, you'd lose the directory for the room you're in.

### The fix

```ts
const { [roomId]: _previous, ...otherRooms } = readRooms(); // take the current room out

const recentOtherRooms = Object.entries(otherRooms)
  .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b.updated - a.updated)
  .slice(0, MAX_ROOMS - 1); // rank only the OTHER rooms (19)

localStorage.setItem(
  KEY,
  JSON.stringify({
    ...Object.fromEntries(recentOtherRooms),
    [roomId]: currentRoom, // current room always added back
  }),
);
```

The current room is never ranked at all. It's always kept, whatever the clock says, and only the other 19 slots are filled by recency.

## "A leaves the room": my wording was unclear

What you saw is correct. My table didn't explain the terms properly, so here's the difference between the three things that could be meant:

| What happens | Effect on **that client's** `collaboratorDirectory` | Effect on the room |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Someone else** leaves (closes their tab) | **They stay listed.** That's the point of Previously seen: they're kept, with a refreshed `lastSeen` | The room continues |
| **You click "Stop session"** (Share button → Stop session) | Becomes **`null`**, and your hidden set is cleared. Your tab goes back to solo drawing | **The room continues** for everyone else. Stopping your own session never shuts the room |
| **You close your tab** | There's no state left to inspect. The **saved** directory stays in `localStorage` and loads again when you rejoin | The room continues |

So my row meant **"you click Stop session"**, and it checks only that client's state. The room staying open for the others is correct and expected. Excalidraw rooms have no owner who can close them.

To check it:

1. On A, open the Share dialog and click **Stop session**. Choose either option in the confirmation.
2. On A, `h.state.collaboratorDirectory` → `null`, and `h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size` → `0`.
3. On B, the room is still running, and A now appears under Previously seen (see below).

### Seeing "In the room" vs "Previously seen" now

The directory always holds **everyone seen**. Splitting it into sections is a display decision, made by comparing it with the live `h.state.collaborators`. Step 6 does this in the dropdown. Until then, this console helper shows the same split:

```js
const sections = () => {
  const live = new Set(
    [...h.state.collaborators.values()].map((c) => c.id).filter(Boolean),
  );
  console.table(
    [...(h.state.collaboratorDirectory ?? new Map())].map(([id, e]) => ({
      id,
      name: e.username,
      section: live.has(id) ? "In the room" : "Previously seen",
    })),
  );
};
```

After someone closes their tab, run `sections()` on another client. That person should move from **In the room** to **Previously seen**.

```text
import { CODES, KEYS } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { CaptureUpdateAction } from "@excalidraw/element";

import { eyeIcon } from "../components/icons";

import { register } from "./register";

export const actionToggleViewMode = register({
  name: "viewMode",
  label: "labels.viewMode",
  icon: eyeIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: {
    category: "canvas",
    predicate: (appState) => !appState.viewModeEnabled,
  },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    return {
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        viewModeEnabled: !this.checked!(appState),
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.EVENTUALLY,
    };
  },
  checked: (appState) => appState.viewModeEnabled,
  predicate: (elements, appState, appProps) => {
    return typeof appProps.viewModeEnabled === "undefined";
  },
  keyTest: (event) =>
    !event[KEYS.CTRL_OR_CMD] && event.altKey && event.code === CODES.R,
});
import { CODES, DEFAULT_GRID_OPACITY, KEYS } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { CaptureUpdateAction } from "@excalidraw/element";

import { gridIcon } from "../components/icons";

import { register } from "./register";

export const actionToggleGridMode = register({
  name: "gridMode",
  icon: gridIcon,
  keywords: ["grid"],
  label: "labels.toggleGrid",
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: {
    category: "canvas",
    predicate: (appState) => appState.gridModeEnabled,
  },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    const gridModeEnabled = !this.checked!(appState);
    return {
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        gridModeEnabled,
        // opacity 0 hid the grid, so showing it again starts fully visible.
        // Hiding it keeps the opacity to restore it as it was.
        gridOpacity:
          gridModeEnabled && appState.gridOpacity === 0
            ? DEFAULT_GRID_OPACITY
            : appState.gridOpacity,
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.EVENTUALLY,
    };
  },
  checked: (appState) => appState.gridModeEnabled,
  predicate: (element, appState, props) => {
    return props.gridModeEnabled === undefined;
  },
  keyTest: (event) => event[KEYS.CTRL_OR_CMD] && event.code === CODES.QUOTE,
});
```

```text
import { CloseIcon } from "../icons";

import "./FollowMode.scss";

import type { UserToFollow } from "../../types";

interface FollowModeProps {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  userToFollow: UserToFollow;
  onDisconnect: () => void;
}

const FollowMode = ({
  height,
  width,
  userToFollow,
  onDisconnect,
}: FollowModeProps) => {
  return (
    <div className="follow-mode" style={{ width, height }}>
      <div className="follow-mode__badge">
        <div className="follow-mode__badge__label">
          Following{" "}
          <span
            className="follow-mode__badge__username"
            title={userToFollow.username}
          >
            {userToFollow.username}
          </span>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onDisconnect}
          className="follow-mode__disconnect-btn"
        >
          {CloseIcon}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default FollowMode;
```

```bash
/** this client's creator id (set by the host app on the current user's entry) */
export const getSelfCollaboratorId = ({
  collaborators,
}: Pick<AppState, "collaborators">): string | null => {
  for (const collaborator of collaborators.values()) {
    if (collaborator.isCurrentUser && collaborator.id) {
      return collaborator.id;
    }
  }
  return null;
};

/**
 * Whether the user hid their own drawings. Anything they'd draw would be
 * hidden immediately, so the editor is locked to view mode meanwhile.
 */
export const isOwnDrawingsHidden = (
  appState: Pick<AppState, "collaborators" | "hiddenCollaboratorIds">,
): boolean => {
  const selfId = getSelfCollaboratorId(appState);
  return !!selfId && appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(selfId);
};

/**
 * Every visibility bucket currently known on this client: live
 * collaborators, previously seen ones, creators of the scene's elements and
 * the miscellaneous bucket. "Hide all" hides all of these.
 */
export const getVisibilityBuckets = (
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: Pick<AppState, "collaborators" | "collaboratorDirectory">,
): Set<string> => {
  const buckets = new Set<string>([UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);

  for (const collaborator of appState.collaborators.values()) {
    if (collaborator.id) {
      buckets.add(collaborator.id);
    }
  }
  for (const clientId of appState.collaboratorDirectory?.keys() ?? []) {
    buckets.add(clientId);
  }

  const elementsMap = arrayToMap(elements);
  for (const element of elements) {
    if (!element.isDeleted) {
      buckets.add(
        getElementVisibilityBucket(
          element,
          elementsMap,
          appState.collaboratorDirectory,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  return buckets;
};
```

```typescript
import { CaptureUpdateAction } from "@excalidraw/element";

import { eyeClosedIcon, eyeIcon } from "../components/icons";
import { getVisibilityBuckets } from "../scene/visibility";

import { register } from "./register";

/*
 * Local-only visibility of collaborators' drawings. These only change
 * `appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds` (never synced, never in history); hiding
 * your own drawings locks view mode (enforced in App.componentDidUpdate).
 */

/** toggles one visibility bucket (a creator id, or UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID) */
export const actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility = register<string>({
  name: "toggleCollaboratorVisibility",
  label: "collaboratorVisibility.toggle",
  icon: eyeIcon,
  // must work in view mode: it's how you get out of the self-hide lock
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState, bucketId) {
    if (!bucketId) {
      return false;
    }
    const hiddenCollaboratorIds = new Set(appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds);
    if (!hiddenCollaboratorIds.delete(bucketId)) {
      hiddenCollaboratorIds.add(bucketId);
    }
    return {
      appState: { ...appState, hiddenCollaboratorIds },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});

export const actionShowAllCollaborators = register({
  name: "showAllCollaborators",
  label: "collaboratorVisibility.showAll",
  icon: eyeIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    return {
      appState: { ...appState, hiddenCollaboratorIds: new Set() },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
  predicate: (elements, appState) => appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size > 0,
});

/** hides everyone, including yourself (which locks view mode) */
export const actionHideAllCollaborators = register({
  name: "hideAllCollaborators",
  label: "collaboratorVisibility.hideAll",
  icon: eyeClosedIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    return {
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        hiddenCollaboratorIds: getVisibilityBuckets(elements, appState),
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});
```

```bash
describe("collaborator visibility (actions + own-drawings lock)", () => {
  const collaborators = new Map([
    ["my-socket", { id: "me", isCurrentUser: true }],

  ]) as unknown as AppState["collaborators"];

  const execute = (
    action:

      | typeof actionShowAllCollaborators
      | typeof actionHideAllCollaborators
      | typeof actionToggleViewMode,
    value?: string,
  ) => {
    act(() => {
      h.app.actionManager.executeAction(action, "ui", value as any);
    });
  };

  const hidden = () => [...h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds].sort();
  const isBannerShown = () => !!document.querySelector(".own-drawings-hidden");

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await render(<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />);
    API.setElements([
      stamp(createRect("alice-rect", 0), "alice"),
      stamp(createRect("bob-rect", 20), "bob"),
    ]);
    act(() => {
      h.app.updateScene({ collaborators });
    });
  });

  it("toggles one bucket on and off", () => {
    execute(actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility, "alice");
    expect(hidden()).toEqual(["alice"]);

    execute(actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility, "alice");
    expect(hidden()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("hide all hides every known bucket, including your own", () => {
    execute(actionHideAllCollaborators);
    // live (me, alice) + scene creators (bob) + miscellaneous
    expect(hidden()).toEqual(["alice", "bob", "me", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID].sort());
  });

  it("show all clears everything", () => {
    execute(actionHideAllCollaborators);
    execute(actionShowAllCollaborators);
    expect(hidden()).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it("never adds undo history entries", () => {
    const undoStackSize = API.getUndoStack().length;
    execute(actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility, "alice");
    execute(actionHideAllCollaborators);
    execute(actionShowAllCollaborators);
    expect(API.getUndoStack().length).toBe(undoStackSize);
  });

  it("(control) hiding others doesn't lock view mode", () => {
    execute(actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility, "alice");
    expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(false);
    expect(isBannerShown()).toBe(false);
  });

  it("hiding your own drawings locks view mode and shows the hint", () => {
    execute(actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility, "me");

    expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(true);
    expect(h.state.viewModeBeforeSelfHide).toBe(false);
    expect(isBannerShown()).toBe(true);
  });

  it("view mode can't be exited while your drawings are hidden", () => {
    execute(actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility, "me");

    // keyboard shortcut (Alt+R) — doesn't consult predicates
    Keyboard.withModifierKeys({ alt: true }, () => {
      Keyboard.codePress(CODES.R);
    });
    expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(true);

    // menu / API
    execute(actionToggleViewMode);
    expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(true);

    // direct state change (e.g. host app) is reverted
    act(() => {
      API.setAppState({ viewModeEnabled: false });
    });
    expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(true);
  });

  it("the hint's button shows your drawings and unlocks", () => {
    execute(actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility, "me");

    act(() => {
      (
        document.querySelector(
          ".own-drawings-hidden__show-btn",
        ) as HTMLButtonElement
      ).click();
    });

    expect(hidden()).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(false);
    expect(h.state.viewModeBeforeSelfHide).toBe(null);
    expect(isBannerShown()).toBe(false);
  });

  it("restores the view mode you had before (if already in view mode)", () => {
    act(() => {
      API.setAppState({ viewModeEnabled: true });
    });
    execute(actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility, "me");
    execute(actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility, "me");

    expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(true);
    expect(h.state.viewModeBeforeSelfHide).toBe(null);

    expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(true);

    setHidden([]);
    expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(false);
    expect(isBannerShown()).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

## Step 5 done: the actions and the view-mode lock

The typecheck and lint pass, and the full suite passes: 128 files, 1,900 tests, with 11 new tests. The only snapshot changes are 133 lines of `"viewModeBeforeSelfHide": null`. The Mermaid snapshot was **not** rewritten this time.

The buttons' logic is now in place, without the dropdown UI (that's step 6). You can already trigger all of it from the console, and the "your drawings are hidden" banner is real UI.

### How it works

```
 UI (step 6) / console / banner
   └─► actionManager.executeAction(action, "ui", bucketId)
         ├─ toggleCollaboratorVisibility(bucketId)  add/remove one bucket
         ├─ showAllCollaborators                    ∅
         └─ hideAllCollaborators                    getVisibilityBuckets(): live + previously seen
                                                    + scene creators + Miscellaneous (incl. YOU)
         all: viewMode: true (usable while locked) · captureUpdate NEVER (no undo entries)
                    │
                    ▼  appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds
 App.componentDidUpdate — LOCK INVARIANT (holds however the set changed)
   own id hidden?  ── yes ─► not locked yet → viewModeBeforeSelfHide = current; viewModeEnabled = true
         │                  locked but view mode off → force back on
         └─ no, but locked ─► viewModeEnabled = props.viewModeEnabled ?? viewModeBeforeSelfHide; unlock
 actionToggleViewMode (menu + Alt+R)
   perform: no-op while locked   (keyboard shortcuts skip predicates, so it must be here)
   predicate: hidden while locked (menu item disappears)
 OwnDrawingsHiddenBanner (top-centre, FollowMode-style badge)
   "Your drawings are hidden, so editing is paused (view-only) …"  [👁 Show my drawings]
```

**Why the lock is enforced in `componentDidUpdate`, not in the actions:** your own drawings can be hidden in more ways than the three actions, for example Hide all, the host app, or your console's `hide(...)`. They can also be shown again in other ways, such as leaving the room (Collab clears the set). Checking one condition after every update covers all of them, using the same pattern as the selection safety net.

### Files changed in step 5

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| [actions/actionCollaboratorVisibility.ts](packages/excalidraw/actions/actionCollaboratorVisibility.ts) **NEW** | The three actions. Each only changes `hiddenCollaboratorIds`, with `captureUpdate: NEVER` and `viewMode: true` |
| [actions/actionToggleViewMode.tsx](packages/excalidraw/actions/actionToggleViewMode.tsx) | Does nothing while locked (covers Alt+R), and the menu item is hidden while locked |
| [actions/types.ts](packages/excalidraw/actions/types.ts), [actions/index.ts](packages/excalidraw/actions/index.ts) | Register the three action names and export them |
| [scene/visibility.ts](packages/excalidraw/scene/visibility.ts) | Added `getSelfCollaboratorId`, `isOwnDrawingsHidden` and `getVisibilityBuckets` |
| [types.ts](packages/excalidraw/types.ts), [appState.ts](packages/excalidraw/appState.ts) | Added `viewModeBeforeSelfHide: boolean \| null` (never saved) |
| [components/App.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx) | The lock invariant, `showOwnDrawings()`, and the banner mounted next to `FollowMode` |
| [CollaboratorVisibility/OwnDrawingsHiddenBanner.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/CollaboratorVisibility/OwnDrawingsHiddenBanner.tsx) + [.scss](packages/excalidraw/components/CollaboratorVisibility/OwnDrawingsHiddenBanner.scss) **NEW** | The hint banner, using FollowMode's colours and badge shape, at the top centre (which is empty in view mode) |
| [locales/en.json](packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json) | Five strings under `collaboratorVisibility` |
| [tests/collaboratorVisibility.test.tsx](packages/excalidraw/tests/collaboratorVisibility.test.tsx) | 11 tests (below) |

**Tests:** toggling on and off; Hide all covering live, scene-creator and Miscellaneous buckets **plus you**; Show all; no undo entries; **(control)** hiding others doesn't lock; hiding yourself locks and shows the banner; **(control)** Alt+R does toggle view mode normally; view mode can't be left via **Alt+R, the action, or a direct state change**; the banner's button unlocks; your earlier view mode is restored; and the lock releases when the set is cleared from outside (as when leaving a room).

### Checking it yourself

These run in a room, alongside the earlier console helpers:

```js
const am = h.app.actionManager,
  acts = Object.fromEntries(
    [
      "toggleCollaboratorVisibility",
      "showAllCollaborators",
      "hideAllCollaborators",
    ].map((n) => [n, am.actions[n]]),
  );
const toggle = (id) =>
  am.executeAction(acts.toggleCollaboratorVisibility, "ui", id);
const showAll = () => am.executeAction(acts.showAllCollaborators, "ui");
const hideAll = () => am.executeAction(acts.hideAllCollaborators, "ui");
```

| Try | Expected |
| --- | --- |
| `toggle("<peer's id>")`, then the same call again | Their drawings disappear, then come back. Undo (Ctrl+Z) never reverses a toggle |
| `toggle(me())` | View mode turns on and the **banner** appears at the top. Alt+R does nothing. The main menu's View mode item is gone |
| Click **Show my drawings** in the banner | Your drawings return and editing resumes |
| Turn on view mode (Alt+R), then `toggle(me())` twice | You end up **still in view mode**, as before |
| `hideAll()` | Everything is hidden, including your drawings and Miscellaneous. You're locked, and the banner shows |
| `showAll()` | Everything is visible and the lock is released |
| `hideAll()`, then **Stop session** | The lock is released and editing works, because leaving the room clears the hidden set |

### Two behaviours to confirm

1. **"Hide all" is a snapshot.** It hides every bucket known _at that moment_. A **brand-new** collaborator who joins afterwards is visible, because they weren't part of "all" when you clicked. Their shapes start in Miscellaneous only if they've never identified themselves, and since `USER_IDENTITY` is sent on join, they normally get their own visible row. The alternative is a sticky "hide everyone, including future people" mode. That's more complex, and I'd only add it if you want it.
2. **The host app's view-mode prop.** If a host app forces `viewModeEnabled={false}`, hiding yourself still locks view mode on, and unlocking returns it to the host's value. That doesn't affect excalidraw-app, which doesn't set the prop.

Nothing is committed, and `excalidraw-room` is untouched.

```text
function hashToInteger(id: string) {
  let hash = 0;
  if (id.length === 0) {
    return hash;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < id.length; i++) {
    const char = id.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = (hash << 5) - hash + char;
  }
  return hash;
}

export const getClientColor = (
  socketId: SocketId,
  collaborator: Collaborator | undefined,
) => {
  // to get more even distribution in case `id` is not uniformly distributed to
  // begin with, we hash it
  const hash = Math.abs(hashToInteger(collaborator?.id || socketId));
  // we want to get a multiple of 10 number in the range of 0-360 (in other
  // words a hue value of step size 10). There are 37 such values including 0.
  const hue = (hash % 37) * 10;
  const saturation = 100;
  const lightness = 83;

  return `hsl(${hue}, ${saturation}%, ${lightness}%)`;
};

 * returns first char, capitalized

  // first char can be a surrogate pair, hence using codePointAt
  const firstCodePoint = name?.trim()?.codePointAt(0);
  return (
    firstCodePoint ? String.fromCodePoint(firstCodePoint) : "?"
  ).toUpperCase();
};
```

```bash
cd /c/Users/super/excalidraw; cat >> packages/excalidraw/scene/visibility.ts <<'EOF'

export type CollaboratorVisibilityRow = {
  /** visibility bucket id (client id, or UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID) */
  id: string;
  username: string | null;
  isCurrentUser: boolean;
  isHidden: boolean;
  /** non-deleted elements in this bucket (bound text counts with its shape) */
  drawingsCount: number;
  avatarUrl?: string;
};

export type CollaboratorVisibilityRows = {
  inRoom: CollaboratorVisibilityRow[];
  previouslySeen: CollaboratorVisibilityRow[];
  miscellaneous: CollaboratorVisibilityRow;
};

/**
 * Rows for the collaborator visibility menu:
 * - in the room: live collaborators (you first)
 * - previously seen: directory entries no longer live (most recent first)
 * - miscellaneous: untagged elements + creators this client never saw
 */
export const getCollaboratorVisibilityRows = (
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: Pick<
    AppState,
    "collaborators" | "collaboratorDirectory" | "hiddenCollaboratorIds"
  >,
): CollaboratorVisibilityRows => {
  const elementsMap = arrayToMap(elements);
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const element of elements) {
    if (
      element.isDeleted ||
      // labels count as part of their shape
      (element.type === "text" && element.containerId)
    ) {
      continue;
    }
    const bucket = getElementVisibilityBucket(
      element,
      elementsMap,
      appState.collaboratorDirectory,
    );
    counts.set(bucket, (counts.get(bucket) ?? 0) + 1);
  }

  const toRow = (
    id: string,
    username: string | null,
    extra?: Partial<CollaboratorVisibilityRow>,
  ): CollaboratorVisibilityRow => ({
    id,
    username,
    isCurrentUser: false,
    isHidden: appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(id),
    drawingsCount: counts.get(id) ?? 0,
    ...extra,
  });

  const inRoom = new Map<string, CollaboratorVisibilityRow>();
  for (const collaborator of appState.collaborators.values()) {
    // several tabs can't share an id, but guard against duplicates anyway
    if (collaborator.id && !inRoom.has(collaborator.id)) {
      inRoom.set(
        collaborator.id,
        toRow(
          collaborator.id,
          collaborator.username ??
            appState.collaboratorDirectory?.get(collaborator.id)?.username ??
            null,
          {
            isCurrentUser: !!collaborator.isCurrentUser,
            avatarUrl: collaborator.avatarUrl,
          },
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  const previouslySeen = [...(appState.collaboratorDirectory ?? [])]
    .filter(([id]) => !inRoom.has(id))
    .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b.lastSeen - a.lastSeen)
    .map(([id, entry]) => toRow(id, entry.username));

  return {
    inRoom: [...inRoom.values()].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        Number(b.isCurrentUser) - Number(a.isCurrentUser) ||
        (a.username ?? "").localeCompare(b.username ?? ""),
    ),
    previouslySeen,
    miscellaneous: toRow(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, null),
  };
};
```

```typescript
import { useExcalidrawActionManager, useExcalidrawElements } from "../App";
import { Avatar } from "../Avatar";
import { DotsHorizontalIcon, eyeClosedIcon, eyeIcon } from "../icons";
import { Island } from "../Island";
import { QuickSearch } from "../QuickSearch";

import "./CollaboratorVisibilityMenu.scss";

import type { CollaboratorVisibilityRow } from "../../scene/visibility";
import type { SocketId } from "../../types";

/** same as UserList */
const SHOW_FILTER_AT = 8;

const Row = ({
  row,
  label,
  hint,
  onToggle,
  avatarless,
}: {
  row: CollaboratorVisibilityRow;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  onToggle: (id: string) => void;
  avatarless?: boolean;
}) => (
  <button
    type="button"
    className={clsx("CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__row", {
      "is-hidden": row.isHidden,
    })}
    onClick={() => onToggle(row.id)}
    aria-pressed={!row.isHidden}
    title={t(
      row.isHidden
        ? "collaboratorVisibility.showDrawingsOf"
        : "collaboratorVisibility.hideDrawingsOf",
      { name: label },
    )}
    data-testid={`collaborator-visibility-row-${row.id}`}
  >
    {avatarless ? (
      <span className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__misc-avatar">?</span>
    ) : (
      <Avatar
        // same color as the collaborator's avatar/cursor (hashed from the id)
        color={getClientColor(row.id as SocketId, { id: row.id })}
        name={row.username || "?"}
        src={row.avatarUrl}
        onClick={() => {}}
      />
    )}
    <span className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__row-text">
      <span className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__row-name">{label}</span>
      {hint && (
        <span className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__row-hint">{hint}</span>
      )}
    </span>
    <span
      className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__row-count"
      title={t("collaboratorVisibility.drawingsCount")}
    >
      {row.drawingsCount}
    </span>
    <span className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__row-eye">
      {row.isHidden ? eyeClosedIcon : eyeIcon}
    </span>
  </button>
);

const MenuContent = () => {
  const appState = useUIAppState();
  const elements = useExcalidrawElements();
  const actionManager = useExcalidrawActionManager();
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");

  const rows = useMemo(
    () => getCollaboratorVisibilityRows(elements, appState),
    [elements, appState],
  );

  const getLabel = (row: CollaboratorVisibilityRow) => {
    const name = row.username || t("collaboratorVisibility.unnamed");
    return row.isCurrentUser ? t("collaboratorVisibility.you", { name }) : name;
  };

  const term = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
  const matches = (row: CollaboratorVisibilityRow) =>
    !term || getLabel(row).toLowerCase().includes(term);

  const inRoom = rows.inRoom.filter(matches);
  const previouslySeen = rows.previouslySeen.filter(matches);
  const showSearch =
    rows.inRoom.length + rows.previouslySeen.length >= SHOW_FILTER_AT;

  const toggle = (id: string) =>
    actionManager.executeAction(actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility, "ui", id);

  return (
    <div className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__content">
      <div className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__title">
        {t("collaboratorVisibility.title")}
      </div>
      <div className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__bulk">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__bulk-btn"
          onClick={() =>
            actionManager.executeAction(actionShowAllCollaborators, "ui")
          }
          disabled={appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size === 0}
        >
          {eyeIcon}
          {t("collaboratorVisibility.showAllShort")}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__bulk-btn"
          onClick={() =>
            actionManager.executeAction(actionHideAllCollaborators, "ui")
          }
        >
          {eyeClosedIcon}
          {t("collaboratorVisibility.hideAllShort")}
        </button>
      </div>

      {showSearch && (
        <QuickSearch
          placeholder={t("quickSearch.placeholder")}
          onChange={setSearchTerm}
        />
      )}

      <div className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__sections">
        {inRoom.length > 0 && (
          <section>
            <div className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__section-title">
              {t("collaboratorVisibility.inRoom")}
            </div>
            {inRoom.map((row) => (
              <Row
                key={row.id}
                row={row}
                label={getLabel(row)}
                hint={
                  row.isCurrentUser
                    ? t("collaboratorVisibility.ownRowHint")
                    : undefined
                }
                onToggle={toggle}
              />
            ))}
          </section>
        )}

        {previouslySeen.length > 0 && (
          <section>
            <div className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__section-title">
              {t("collaboratorVisibility.previouslySeen")}
            </div>
            {previouslySeen.map((row) => (
              <Row
                key={row.id}
                row={row}
                label={getLabel(row)}
                hint={t("collaboratorVisibility.leftHint")}
                onToggle={toggle}
              />
            ))}
          </section>
        )}

        {/* hidden while filtering by name (it has no name) */}
        {!term && (
          <section>
            <div className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__section-title">
              {t("collaboratorVisibility.miscellaneous")}
            </div>
            <Row
              row={rows.miscellaneous}
              label={t("collaboratorVisibility.miscellaneousRow")}
              hint={t("collaboratorVisibility.miscellaneousHint")}
              onToggle={toggle}
              avatarless
            />
          </section>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * Rounded-square ⋯ button next to the collaborator avatars, opening the
 * local-only drawing visibility controls.
 */
export const CollaboratorVisibilityMenu = ({
  className,
}: {
  className?: string;
}) => {
  const appState = useUIAppState();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const hasHidden = appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size > 0;

  return (
    <Popover.Root open={isOpen} onOpenChange={setIsOpen}>
      <Popover.Trigger
        className={clsx("CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__trigger", className, {
          "is-active": hasHidden,
        })}
        title={t("collaboratorVisibility.title")}
        aria-label={t("collaboratorVisibility.title")}
        data-testid="collaborator-visibility-trigger"
      >
        {DotsHorizontalIcon}
        {hasHidden && (
          <span
            className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__badge"
            data-testid="collaborator-visibility-badge"
          />
        )}
      </Popover.Trigger>
      {isOpen && (
        <Popover.Content
          className="CollaboratorVisibilityMenu__popover"
          align="end"
          sideOffset={10}
          style={{ zIndex: 2 }}
        >
          <Island padding={2}>
            <MenuContent />
          </Island>
        </Popover.Content>
      )}
    </Popover.Root>
  );
};
```

```bash
describe("collaborator visibility (menu rows)", () => {
  const directory = new Map([
    ["me", { username: "Me", lastSeen: 3 }],
    ["alice", { username: "Alice", lastSeen: 3 }],
    ["bob", { username: "Bob", lastSeen: 1 }],
    ["carol", { username: "Carol", lastSeen: 2 }],
  ]);
  const collaborators = new Map([
    ["alice-socket", { id: "alice", username: "Alice" }],
    ["my-socket", { id: "me", username: "Me", isCurrentUser: true }],
  ]) as unknown as AppState["collaborators"];

  const container = stamp(createRect("container", 0), "bob");
  const label = stamp(
    API.createElement({ type: "text", id: "label", containerId: "container" }),
    "alice",
  );
  const elements = [
    stamp(createRect("alice-1", 0), "alice"),
    stamp(createRect("alice-2", 0), "alice"),
    newElementWith(stamp(createRect("alice-deleted", 0), "alice"), {
      isDeleted: true,
    }),
    container,
    label,
    stamp(createRect("never-seen", 0), "dave"),
    createRect("legacy", 0),
  ];

  const getRows = (hidden: string[] = []) =>
    getCollaboratorVisibilityRows(elements, {
      collaborators,
      collaboratorDirectory: directory,
      hiddenCollaboratorIds: new Set(hidden),
    });

  it("lists live collaborators first, you on top", () => {
    expect(getRows().inRoom.map((row) => [row.id, row.isCurrentUser])).toEqual([
      ["me", true],
      ["alice", false],
    ]);
  });

  it("lists previously seen (not live) collaborators, most recent first", () => {
    expect(getRows().previouslySeen.map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([
      "carol",
      "bob",
    ]);
  });

  it("counts non-deleted drawings; labels count with their shape", () => {
    const { inRoom, previouslySeen } = getRows();
    expect(inRoom.find((row) => row.id === "alice")!.drawingsCount).toBe(2);
    expect(previouslySeen.find((row) => row.id === "bob")!.drawingsCount).toBe(
      1,
    );
  });

  it("groups untagged and never-seen creators into miscellaneous", () => {
    expect(getRows().miscellaneous).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ id: UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, drawingsCount: 2 }),
    );
  });

  it("reflects hidden state per row", () => {
    const rows = getRows(["bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
    expect(rows.previouslySeen.find((row) => row.id === "bob")!.isHidden).toBe(
      true,
    );
    expect(rows.inRoom.every((row) => !row.isHidden)).toBe(true);
    expect(rows.miscellaneous.isHidden).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("collaborator visibility (menu UI)", () => {
  const collaborators = new Map([
    ["my-socket", { id: "me", username: "Me", isCurrentUser: true }],
    ["alice-socket", { id: "alice", username: "Alice" }],
  ]) as unknown as AppState["collaborators"];

  const queryTrigger = () =>
    document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
      "[data-testid='collaborator-visibility-trigger']",
    );
  const queryRow = (id: string) =>
    document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
      `[data-testid='collaborator-visibility-row-${id}']`,
    );
  const queryBadge = () =>
    document.querySelector("[data-testid='collaborator-visibility-badge']");
  const clickButton = (label: string) =>
    fireEvent.click(
      [...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(
        (button) => button.textContent === label,
      )!,
    );

  const openMenu = () => {
    fireEvent.click(queryTrigger()!);
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await render(<Excalidraw />);
    API.setElements([stamp(createRect("alice-rect", 0), "alice")]);
  });

  it("is only shown while collaborating", () => {
    expect(queryTrigger()).toBe(null);

    act(() => {
      h.app.updateScene({ collaborators });
    });
    expect(queryTrigger()).not.toBe(null);
  });

  describe("while collaborating", () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      act(() => {
        h.app.updateScene({
          collaborators,
          appState: {
            collaboratorDirectory: new Map([
              ["me", { username: "Me", lastSeen: 2 }],
              ["alice", { username: "Alice", lastSeen: 2 }],
              ["bob", { username: "Bob", lastSeen: 1 }],
            ]),
          },
        });
      });
    });

    it("opens with all three sections", () => {
      openMenu();

      expect(queryRow("me")!.textContent).toContain("Me (you)");
      expect(queryRow("alice")).not.toBe(null);
      expect(queryRow("bob")!.textContent).toContain("Left the room");
      expect(queryRow(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID)).not.toBe(null);
    });

    it("toggles a collaborator from their row and shows the badge", () => {
      openMenu();
      expect(queryBadge()).toBe(null);

      fireEvent.click(queryRow("alice")!);
      expect([...h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds]).toEqual(["alice"]);
      expect(queryRow("alice")!.getAttribute("aria-pressed")).toBe("false");
      expect(queryBadge()).not.toBe(null);

      fireEvent.click(queryRow("alice")!);
      expect(h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size).toBe(0);
      expect(queryBadge()).toBe(null);
    });

    it("hide all / show all buttons", () => {
      openMenu();

      clickButton("Hide all");
      expect(h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds.has("me")).toBe(true);
      expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(true); // own drawings hidden → lock

      clickButton("Show all");
      expect(h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size).toBe(0);
      expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(false);
    });

    it("stays usable in view mode (the way back from hiding yourself)", () => {
      openMenu();
      fireEvent.click(queryRow("me")!);
      expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(true);

      expect(queryTrigger()).not.toBe(null);
      fireEvent.click(queryRow("me")!);
      expect(h.state.viewModeEnabled).toBe(false);
    });
  });
});
```

## Step 6 done: the UI

The typecheck and lint pass, and the full suite passes: 128 files, 1,910 tests, with 10 new tests. No new snapshot changes, and the Mermaid snapshot is untouched.

**An important caveat: I haven't seen this UI rendered.** The tests check structure and behaviour in jsdom, which has no real layout or CSS. **Spacing, colours, dark mode and the phone layout still need your eyes in a browser.** Let me know anything that looks off and I'll adjust it.

### What it looks like (intended)

```
 top-right:   (A)(B)(+2) [⋯]        [⋯•]  ← primary-tinted + dot badge while anything is hidden
                         └ rounded square, avatar-sized, "+N" grey

 ┌ Collaborator visibility ─────────────┐
 │ [👁 Show all]  [👁̸ Hide all]          │   Show all disabled when nothing is hidden
 │ 🔍 Search…            (8+ people)     │
 │ IN THE ROOM                           │
 │ (M) Me (you)                    3  👁 │
 │     Hiding yours pauses editing       │
 │ (A) Alice                       2  👁 │
 │ PREVIOUSLY SEEN                       │
 │ (B) Bob                         1  👁̸ │   ← hidden rows dimmed, eye-closed
 │     Left the room                     │
 │ MISCELLANEOUS                         │
 │ (?) Untagged & unknown          4  👁 │   dashed "?" avatar
 │     Older drawings & people you haven't seen │
 └───────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **Rows:** clicking anywhere on a row toggles it. The number is that person's drawing count (labels count with their shape, deleted shapes aren't counted). The avatar colour comes from their ID, so it **matches their live avatar and cursor colour**.
- **In view mode:** the button stays available, because the avatars are always rendered, so the menu is a second way out of the self-hide lock besides the banner.
- **On phones:** the same button appears next to the avatars inside the main menu's **Collaborators** section.

### Files changed in step 6

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| [CollaboratorVisibility/CollaboratorVisibilityMenu.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/CollaboratorVisibility/CollaboratorVisibilityMenu.tsx) **NEW** | The trigger button, a Radix popover (same as UserList's), the bulk buttons, search, the three sections and the rows. It reads state through context hooks, so it can be mounted anywhere. Row counts are only computed while the menu is open |
| [CollaboratorVisibility/CollaboratorVisibilityMenu.scss](packages/excalidraw/components/CollaboratorVisibility/CollaboratorVisibilityMenu.scss) **NEW** | Uses only existing theme variables, plus dark-mode styling for the trigger, the badge and the phone row layout (kept here, not in upstream's `styles.scss`) |
| [scene/visibility.ts](packages/excalidraw/scene/visibility.ts) | `getCollaboratorVisibilityRows()`: the pure rules for sections, sorting (you first, Previously seen by most recent) and counts |
| [components/LayerUI.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/LayerUI.tsx) | Mounts the button right after `<UserList>`. The top-right container is a flex row, so it lands to the right of the avatars **without changing UserList** |
| [main-menu/MainMenu.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/main-menu/MainMenu.tsx) | The phone version: the avatars and the button in one row |
| [locales/en.json](packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json) | 15 strings under `collaboratorVisibility` |
| [tests/collaboratorVisibility.test.tsx](packages/excalidraw/tests/collaboratorVisibility.test.tsx) | 5 tests on the row builder (you first, Previously seen order, counts excluding deleted shapes and counting labels with their shape, Miscellaneous grouping, hidden state) and 5 UI tests using real clicks (shown only while collaborating, all three sections, a row toggle with `aria-pressed` and the badge, Hide all → locked → Show all, usable in view mode) |

### Checking it yourself

Restart `yarn start`, then use the multi-client setup (Brave ×2, Edge):

1. **Look:** create a room. The ⋯ button appears to the right of the avatars. Check it in **light and dark** themes.
2. **Sections:** with 3 clients, each client's menu lists itself first, marked "(you)", then the others. Close one client and its row moves to **Previously seen**, marked "Left the room".
3. **Toggling:** click Alice's row. Her drawings disappear, her row dims, the eye closes, and the button **badge** appears. Click again to undo.
4. **Miscellaneous:** in an older room with unstamped shapes, the row shows their count, and toggling it hides them.
5. **Hide all:** everything disappears, the banner appears, and you're locked. Reopen the menu, click your own row (or **Show all**), and you're unlocked.
6. **Search:** with 8 or more people listed, a search box appears and filters by name.
7. **Phone:** shrink the window to phone width (or use DevTools device mode), open ☰. The button sits next to the avatars under Collaborators.

### Possible tweaks once you've seen it

- **Trigger icon:** the agreed ⋯ (`DotsHorizontalIcon`). You might prefer an eye icon, since ⋯ next to `+N` could read as "more people".
- **Counts:** shown as a bare number with a "Drawings" tooltip. It could say "3 drawings" instead.
- **Previously seen with 0 drawings:** these are listed too, as you asked. They could be hidden to keep the list shorter.

Nothing is committed, and `excalidraw-room` is untouched. All six steps are now implemented. After you've checked the UI, the remaining items are any visual adjustments, the follow-up tests you postponed (JSON save, shareable link and Excalidraw+ export, dragging an arrow bound to a hidden shape), and committing or opening a PR when you're ready.

# Collaborator visibility: final recap

**Branch:** `feat/visibility-controls`, nothing committed. **Size:** 30 modified files (+1,043 / −41) and 15 new files. **Tests:** 80 new tests. The full suite passes (128 files, 1,910 tests), along with the typecheck and lint.

---

## 1. Architecture: layers and dependency direction

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ HOST APP  excalidraw-app/                                         (knows WHO you are) │
│  collab/clientIdentity.ts   per-tab id pool        collab/creatorStamp.ts  stamp rule │
│  collab/collaboratorDirectory.ts  per-room "seen"  collab/Collab.tsx + Portal.tsx     │
│  data/index.ts · app_constants.ts (protocol + keys)   App.tsx (link / Excalidraw+)    │
└───────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                │ feeds via public API: updateScene({collaborators, appState}),
                │ mutateElement, getLocallyVisibleElements
┌───────────────▼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ EDITOR  packages/excalidraw/                              (knows WHAT is hidden)      │
│  types.ts / appState.ts   hiddenCollaboratorIds · collaboratorDirectory ·             │
│                           viewModeBeforeSelfHide   (all never persisted/synced)       │
│  scene/visibility.ts      editor-side rules (selection net, self, buckets, rows)      │
│  scene/Renderer.ts · components/App.tsx · eraser · SearchMenu · data/index.ts ·       │
│  actions/actionExport.tsx · actions/actionCollaboratorVisibility.ts · ToggleViewMode  │
│  components/CollaboratorVisibility/*  ·  LayerUI.tsx · MainMenu.tsx                   │
└───────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                │ imports
┌───────────────▼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ELEMENT  packages/element/                           (pure data rules, no UI/state)   │
│  ownership.ts   getElementCreatorId · getElementVisibilityBucket ·                    │
│                 isElementByHiddenCreator · excludeElementsByHiddenCreators            │
│  groups.ts (selection chokepoint) · binding.ts + arrows/focus.ts (binding chokepoint) │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 SERVER  excalidraw-room: unchanged (blind encrypted relay)
```

- **Dependencies only point downward.** The element package never imports the editor at runtime (ESLint enforces this), and the editor never imports the host app.
- **The rule is implemented once.** `isElementByHiddenCreator` in [ownership.ts:79](packages/element/src/ownership.ts#L79) is the single definition. Every filter calls it directly, or through `isElementHiddenLocally` ([visibility.ts:26](packages/excalidraw/scene/visibility.ts#L26)), which delegates to it.

---

## 2. End-to-end flow

```
 TAB OPENS ROOM
   Collab.startCollaboration ─► clientId = await getClientId()   (pool + Web Locks + sessionStorage)
     ├─ load directory[roomId], record self ─► appState.collaboratorDirectory, hidden = ∅
     ├─ NEW room:  stamp all my elements ─► first Firebase save already stamped
     └─ JOIN room: initializeRoom ─► loadFromFirebase ─► mark all remote
                   socketInitialized ─► USER_IDENTITY ─► publish directory (after resetScene)
 PEER JOINS ─► Portal "new-user" ─► INIT scene + USER_IDENTITY
 MESSAGES IN ─► USER_IDENTITY / MOUSE_LOCATION / IDLE_STATUS ─► updateCollaborator {id: clientId}
              ─► recordSighting ─► directory (saved per room) ─► appState
 ELEMENTS IN ─► _reconcileElements ─► ids NOT already in my scene → remoteElementIds
 LOCAL EDIT ─► onChange ─► syncElements ─► stamp (not remote ∧ not mine) in place, version++ ─► broadcast

 USER CLICKS (menu / banner / console)
   ─► actionToggle… / ShowAll / HideAll ─► appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds (NEVER in history)
        │
        ▼  bucket = creatorId if in directory (or no directory), else "__unknown__" (Misc)
   ┌────────────── RENDER ───────────────┬──────────── INTERACT ─────────────┬──── EXPORT ────┐
   │ Renderer map (+memo key)            │ getElementsAtPosition / box-select│ image export,  │
   │ embeddables · frame names           │ text container · frame drop ·     │ copy as image, │
   │ selection outlines (same map)       │ motion-path target · search       │ Save/Save as,  │
   │                                     │ eraser group expansion            │ link, Ex+      │
   │                                     │ CHOKEPOINT selectGroupsFor…       │                │
   │                                     │ CHOKEPOINT binding dispatcher     │                │
   │                                     │ NET componentDidUpdate selection  │                │
   └─────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────┴────────────────┘
   App.componentDidUpdate LOCK: own id hidden ⇒ viewModeEnabled = true (+ banner); released on show
 NEVER FILTERED: Scene data · syncElements/broadcast · Firebase · localStorage autosave · updateArrowBindings
```

## 4. Guarantees, and where each is enforced

| Guarantee | Enforced by |
| --- | --- |
| Hiding never changes shared data | Filters only run _after_ the scene. Test: "does not modify scene data when hiding" (version, versionNonce, isDeleted) |
| Hidden elements can't be deleted or changed by you | Hit-test filters + selection chokepoint + `componentDidUpdate` safety net + eraser fix |
| No new bindings to hidden shapes; existing ones kept | Binding dispatcher filtered; `updateArrowBindings` left unfiltered |
| A shape's owner never changes when edited; pastes belong to the paster | `remoteElementIds` uses "first arrival, not already in my scene" + `getElementsToStamp` |
| Visibility choices are never saved or synced, and don't carry over between rooms | `APP_STATE_STORAGE_CONF` all false; Collab resets the set on room start and leave; `resetScene` on join |
| Hiding yourself ⇒ view-only | The `componentDidUpdate` invariant + the action guard |
| Exports match what's visible at that moment | Every export entry point uses `getLocallyVisibleElements` |
| Compatible with older clients | Optional `clientId`; `assertNever(…, null)` ignores the unknown message type |
