---

## 6. Known limitations and open items

- **Elbow-arrow drag preview:** the route can bend toward a hidden shape while you drag, but the arrow won't bind there. Stacking order may raise **your own** arrow above a hidden shape.
- **Hide all is a snapshot:** people who join afterwards are visible.
- **Stamping waits for the room to load:** a shape that's still unstamped when its tab reloads stays Miscellaneous.
- **Tests postponed by agreement:** JSON save, the shareable link and Excalidraw+ export, and dragging an arrow bound to a hidden shape.

## 7. Housekeeping before committing

- **The Mermaid snapshot is flaky:** `yarn test:update` can rewrite `MermaidToExcalidraw.test.tsx.snap` under load. Check `git diff` on that file before committing, and restore it if it changed.
- **`excalidraw-room/` is inside the repo:** it's untracked, so make sure it isn't committed. It also makes `yarn fix` fail and reformat it, so lint with the file list instead.
- **CLAUDE.md asks for `yarn test:update` before committing,** and the snapshot changes need to be included in the commit.

If your team will review this too, I can publish this recap as a shareable page.

```javascript
// Usage: node uncovered.js <repoRoot> <coverage-final.json>
// Lists statements/functions/branch arms with 0 hits on lines added by the
// current working-tree changes (git diff + untracked files).
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const { execSync } = require("child_process");

const [repo, coverageFile] = process.argv.slice(2);
const coverage = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(coverageFile, "utf8"));
const norm = (p) => path.resolve(p).replace(/\\/g, "/").toLowerCase();

const added = new Map(); // normPath -> Set(line)
const diff = execSync("git diff -U0 -- . ':(exclude)*.snap'", {
  cwd: repo,
  encoding: "utf8",
  maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
});
let current = null;
for (const line of diff.split("\n")) {
  const file = line.match(/^\+\+\+ b\/(.*)$/);
  if (file) {
    current = norm(path.join(repo, file[1]));
    added.set(current, added.get(current) || new Set());
    continue;
  }
  const hunk = line.match(/^@@ -\d+(?:,\d+)? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@/);
  if (hunk && current) {
    const start = +hunk[1];
    const count = hunk[2] === undefined ? 1 : +hunk[2];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      added.get(current).add(start + i);
    }
  }
}
const untracked = execSync("git ls-files --others --exclude-standard", {
  cwd: repo,
  encoding: "utf8",
})
  .split("\n")
  .filter((f) => /\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(f) && !f.startsWith("excalidraw-room/"));
for (const f of untracked) {
  const p = path.join(repo, f);
  const n = fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8").split("\n").length;
  added.set(norm(p), new Set(Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => i + 1)));
}

const results = [];
for (const [file, data] of Object.entries(coverage)) {
  const lines = added.get(norm(file));
  if (!lines || /\.test\.tsx?$/.test(file)) {
    continue;
  }
  const src = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8").split("\n");
  const hits = new Map();
  const add = (line, kind) => {
    if (!lines.has(line)) {
      return;
    }
    hits.set(line, new Set([...(hits.get(line) || []), kind]));
  };
  for (const [id, loc] of Object.entries(data.statementMap)) {
    if (data.s[id] === 0) {
      add(loc.start.line, "stmt");
    }
  }
  for (const [id, fn] of Object.entries(data.fnMap)) {
    if (data.f[id] === 0) {
      add(fn.loc.start.line, "fn");
    }
  }
  for (const [id, br] of Object.entries(data.branchMap)) {
    data.b[id].forEach((count, i) => {
      if (count === 0 && br.locations[i]) {
        add(br.locations[i].start.line, "branch");
      }
    });
  }
  if (hits.size) {
    results.push([path.relative(repo, file).replace(/\\/g, "/"), hits, src]);
  }
}

const tracked = [...added.keys()].filter(
  (f) => !Object.keys(coverage).some((c) => norm(c) === f),
);
for (const [file, hits, src] of results.sort()) {
  console.log(`\n== ${file}`);
  for (const [line, kinds] of [...hits].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])) {
    console.log(
      `  ${String(line).padStart(5)} [${[...kinds].join(",")}] ${src[line - 1]
        .trim()
        .slice(0, 110)}`,
    );
  }
}
console.log(
  "\n(files with added lines but no coverage data, e.g. scss/json/tests):",
);
console.log(
  tracked
    .map((f) => path.relative(norm(repo), f))
    .filter((f) => !/\.(scss|json|snap)$|test/.test(f))
    .join("\n") || "  none",
);
```

/**
 * Collaboration-side behaviour of collaborator visibility, driven through the
 * real Collab/Portal classes with a socket that records what's sent and lets
 * tests deliver messages (encryption is a passthrough).
 */
import { CaptureUpdateAction } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw";
import { API } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api";
import { act, render, waitFor } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/test-utils";
import {
  CREATOR_ID_KEY,
  newElementWith,
  syncInvalidIndices,
} from "@excalidraw/element";
import { vi } from "vitest";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";
import type { SocketId } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/types";

import { WS_EVENTS, WS_SUBTYPES } from "../app_constants";
import ExcalidrawApp from "../App";

import type { SocketUpdateDataSource } from "../data";

const { h } = window;

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  handlers: new Map<string, (...args: any[]) => any>(),
  emitted: [] as any[][],
  storedRoomElements: null as readonly any[] | null,
}));

vi.mock("socket.io-client", () => ({
  default: () => ({
    id: "my-socket",
    on: (event: string, handler: (...args: any[]) => any) => {
      mocks.handlers.set(event, handler);
    },
    once: () => {},
    off: () => {},
    emit: (...args: any[]) => {
      mocks.emitted.push(args);
    },
    close: () => {},
  }),
}));

vi.mock("@excalidraw/excalidraw/data/encryption", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<object>()),
  generateEncryptionKey: async () => "test-room-key",
  encryptData: async (_key: string, data: Uint8Array) => ({
    encryptedBuffer: data,
    iv: new Uint8Array(12),
  }),
  decryptData: async (_iv: Uint8Array, data: ArrayBuffer) => data,
}));

vi.mock("../data/firebase", () => ({
  loadFromFirebase: async () => mocks.storedRoomElements,
  saveToFirebase: async () => null,
  isSavedToFirebase: () => true,
  loadFilesFromFirebase: async () => ({ loadedFiles: [], erroredFiles: [] }),
  saveFilesToFirebase: async () => ({
    savedFiles: new Map(),
    erroredFiles: new Map(),
  }),
}));

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

const stamp = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(element: T, creatorId: string) =>
  newElementWith(element as ExcalidrawElement, {
    customData: { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: creatorId },
  }) as T;

const getCreatorId = (id: string) =>
  h.elements.find((el) => el.id === id)?.customData?.[CREATOR_ID_KEY];

/** messages this client broadcast (decoded) */
const getSentMessages = () =>
  mocks.emitted
    .filter(([event]) => event === WS_EVENTS.SERVER)
    .map(([, , buffer]) => JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buffer)));

const getSentOfType = (type: WS_SUBTYPES) =>
  getSentMessages().filter((message) => message.type === type);

/** simulates a message from another client arriving through the room */
const deliver = async (
  message: SocketUpdateDataSource[keyof SocketUpdateDataSource],
) => {
  await act(async () => {
    await mocks.handlers.get("client-broadcast")!(
      new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(message)),
      new Uint8Array(12),
    );
  });
};

const triggerServerEvent = async (event: string, ...args: any[]) => {
  await act(async () => {
    await mocks.handlers.get(event)!(...args);
  });
};

/** local changes reach Collab through onChange → syncElements */
const sync = () => {
  act(() => {
    window.collab.syncElements(h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted());
  });
};

const startCollaboration = async (
  roomLinkData: { roomId: string; roomKey: string } | null = null,
) => {
  let scenePromise!: ReturnType<typeof window.collab.startCollaboration>;
  act(() => {
    scenePromise = window.collab.startCollaboration(roomLinkData);
  });
  await waitFor(() => expect(mocks.handlers.has("first-in-room")).toBe(true));
  return scenePromise;
};

/** start a new room and finish initialization (we're alone in it) */
const startNewRoom = async () => {
  await startCollaboration();
  await triggerServerEvent("first-in-room");
  await waitFor(() =>
    expect(window.collab.portal.socketInitialized).toBe(true),
  );
};

const getClientId = () => window.collab.getClientId()!;

describe("collaborator visibility (collaboration)", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    mocks.handlers.clear();
    mocks.emitted.length = 0;
    mocks.storedRoomElements = null;
    localStorage.clear();
    sessionStorage.clear();
    // a previous test's room link would make the app auto-join that room
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", window.location.origin);
    await render(<ExcalidrawApp />);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  describe("identity", () => {
    it("announces its identity once the room is initialized", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();

      expect(getSentOfType(WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY)).toEqual([
        expect.objectContaining({
          payload: expect.objectContaining({
            socketId: "my-socket",
            clientId: getClientId(),
          }),
        }),
      ]);
    });

    it("introduces itself to newcomers (new-user)", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;

      await triggerServerEvent("new-user", "peer-socket");

      expect(getSentMessages().map((message) => message.type)).toEqual([
        WS_SUBTYPES.INIT,
        WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY,
      ]);
    });

    it("re-announces itself when renaming", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;

      act(() => {
        window.collab.setUsername("Renamed");
      });

      expect(getSentOfType(WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY)).toEqual([
        expect.objectContaining({
          payload: expect.objectContaining({ username: "Renamed" }),
        }),
      ]);
      expect(h.state.collaboratorDirectory?.get(getClientId())?.username).toBe(
        "Renamed",
      );
    });

    it("sends its client id with pointer and idle updates", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;

      await act(async () => {
        await window.collab.portal.broadcastMouseLocation({
          pointer: { x: 0, y: 0, tool: "pointer" },
          button: "up",
        });
        await window.collab.portal.broadcastIdleChange("active" as any);
      });

      const volatile = mocks.emitted
        .filter(([event]) => event === WS_EVENTS.SERVER_VOLATILE)
        .map(([, , buffer]) => JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buffer)));
      expect(volatile.map((message) => message.payload.clientId)).toEqual([
        getClientId(),
        getClientId(),
      ]);
    });

    it("learns peers' ids from USER_IDENTITY, pointer and idle messages", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();

      await deliver({
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY,
        payload: {
          socketId: "alice-socket" as SocketId,
          clientId: "alice",
          username: "Alice",
        },
      });
      await deliver({
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.MOUSE_LOCATION,
        payload: {
          socketId: "bob-socket" as SocketId,
          pointer: { x: 0, y: 0, tool: "pointer" },
          button: "up",
          selectedElementIds: {},
          username: "Bob",
          clientId: "bob",
        },
      });
      await deliver({
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.IDLE_STATUS,
        payload: {
          socketId: "carol-socket" as SocketId,
          userState: "active" as any,
          username: "Carol",
          clientId: "carol",
        },
      });

      const ids = (socketId: string) =>
        h.state.collaborators.get(socketId as SocketId)?.id;
      expect([
        ids("alice-socket"),
        ids("bob-socket"),
        ids("carol-socket"),
      ]).toEqual(["alice", "bob", "carol"]);
      expect(h.state.collaboratorDirectory?.get("alice")?.username).toBe(
        "Alice",
      );
    });

    it("(control) clients without collaborator visibility send no id", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();

      await deliver({
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.MOUSE_LOCATION,
        payload: {
          socketId: "old-socket" as SocketId,
          pointer: { x: 0, y: 0, tool: "pointer" },
          button: "up",
          selectedElementIds: {},
          username: "Old client",
        },
      });

      expect(
        h.state.collaborators.get("old-socket" as SocketId)?.id,
      ).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it("marks its own collaborator entry with its client id", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();

      await triggerServerEvent("room-user-change", [
        "my-socket",
        "alice-socket",
      ]);

      expect(h.state.collaborators.get("my-socket" as SocketId)).toEqual(
        expect.objectContaining({ isCurrentUser: true, id: getClientId() }),
      );
    });

    it("refreshes when it last saw a collaborator who left", async () => {
      const now = vi.spyOn(Date, "now").mockReturnValue(1_000_000);
      await startNewRoom();
      await deliver({
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY,
        payload: {
          socketId: "alice-socket" as SocketId,
          clientId: "alice",
          username: "Alice",
        },
      });

      now.mockReturnValue(1_000_000 + 5 * 60 * 1000);
      await triggerServerEvent("room-user-change", ["my-socket"]);

      expect(h.state.collaboratorDirectory?.get("alice")).toEqual({
        username: "Alice",
        lastSeen: 1_000_000 + 5 * 60 * 1000,
      });
    });
  });

  describe("ownership", () => {
    it("stamps new local elements during sync, never peers' elements", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();

      await deliver({
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
        payload: {
          elements: syncInvalidIndices([
            stamp(API.createElement({ id: "theirs" }), "alice"),
            API.createElement({ id: "legacy" }),
          ]),
        },
      });

      API.updateScene({
        elements: syncInvalidIndices([
          ...h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted(),
          API.createElement({ id: "mine" }),
        ]),
        captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,
      });
      sync();

      expect(getCreatorId("mine")).toBe(getClientId());
      expect(getCreatorId("theirs")).toBe("alice");
      expect(getCreatorId("legacy")).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it("editing a peer's element doesn't transfer ownership", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      await deliver({
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
        payload: {
          elements: syncInvalidIndices([
            stamp(API.createElement({ id: "theirs" }), "alice"),
          ]),
        },
      });

      API.updateElement(h.elements[0], { x: 500 });
      sync();

      expect(getCreatorId("theirs")).toBe("alice");
    });

    it("an echo of our own element doesn't make it remote", async () => {
      await startCollaboration();

      // drawn before the room finished initializing → not stamped yet
      API.updateScene({
        elements: syncInvalidIndices([
          ...h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted(),
          API.createElement({ id: "early" }),
        ]),
        captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,
      });
      sync();
      expect(getCreatorId("early")).toBeUndefined();

      // the room echoes it back (e.g. a peer's full resync)
      await deliver({
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
        payload: {
          elements: h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted(),
        },
      });

      await triggerServerEvent("first-in-room");
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(window.collab.portal.socketInitialized).toBe(true),
      );
      sync();

      expect(getCreatorId("early")).toBe(getClientId());
    });

    it("joining a room never stamps the room's stored elements", async () => {
      mocks.storedRoomElements = syncInvalidIndices([
        stamp(API.createElement({ id: "theirs" }), "alice"),
        API.createElement({ id: "legacy" }),
      ]);

      const scenePromise = await startCollaboration({
        roomId: "room",
        roomKey: "key",
      });
      await triggerServerEvent("first-in-room");
      const scene = await scenePromise;

      // what the app does with the returned scene (App.initializeScene)
      API.updateScene({
        elements: scene!.elements,
        captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
      });
      sync();

      expect(getCreatorId("theirs")).toBe("alice");
      expect(getCreatorId("legacy")).toBeUndefined();
      // and the directory was re-published after the join reset the scene
      expect(h.state.collaboratorDirectory?.has(getClientId())).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});

      type={shareDialogState.type}
    />
  );
};

import { API } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api";
import {
  act,
  fireEvent,
  render,
  screen,
  waitFor,
} from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/test-utils";
import { CREATOR_ID_KEY, newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element";
import { vi } from "vitest";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import { appJotaiStore } from "../app-jotai";
import ExcalidrawApp from "../App";
import { exportToExcalidrawPlus } from "../components/ExportToExcalidrawPlus";
import { exportToBackend } from "../data";
import { shareDialogStateAtom } from "../share/ShareDialog";

  ...(await importOriginal<object>()),
  exportToBackend: vi.fn(async () => ({ url: "https://example.test/#json=x" })),
}));

vi.mock("../components/ExportToExcalidrawPlus", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<object>()),
  exportToExcalidrawPlus: vi.fn(async () => {}),
}));

const stamp = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(element: T, creatorId: string) =>
  newElementWith(element as ExcalidrawElement, {
    customData: { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: creatorId },
  }) as T;

const exportedIds = (fn: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>) =>
  (fn.mock.calls[0][0] as readonly ExcalidrawElement[])
    .map((element) => element.id)
    .sort();

describe("host app exports respect collaborator visibility", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    vi.mocked(exportToBackend).mockClear();
    vi.mocked(exportToExcalidrawPlus).mockClear();
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", window.location.origin);
    await render(<ExcalidrawApp />);
    API.setElements([
      stamp(API.createElement({ id: "alice-rect" }), "alice"),
      stamp(API.createElement({ id: "bob-rect", x: 200 }), "bob"),
    ]);
    act(() => {
      API.setAppState({ hiddenCollaboratorIds: new Set(["bob"]) });
    });
  });

  it("shareable link only contains visible elements", async () => {
    act(() => {
      appJotaiStore.set(shareDialogStateAtom, { isOpen: true, type: "share" });
    });
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByText("Export to Link"));

    await waitFor(() => expect(exportToBackend).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(exportedIds(vi.mocked(exportToBackend))).toEqual(["alice-rect"]);
  });

  it("Excalidraw+ export (command palette) only contains visible elements", async () => {
    act(() => {
      API.setAppState({ openDialog: { name: "commandPalette" } });
    });
    fireEvent.change(
      await screen.findByPlaceholderText(/search/i, {
        selector: ".command-palette-dialog input",
      }),
      { target: { value: "Excalidraw+" } },
    );
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByText("Export to Excalidraw+"));

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(exportToExcalidrawPlus).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1),
    );
    expect(exportedIds(vi.mocked(exportToExcalidrawPlus))).toEqual([
      "alice-rect",
    ]);
  });

    act(() => {
      API.setAppState({ hiddenCollaboratorIds: new Set() });

// Usage: node mutate.js <repoRoot>
// Applies one source mutation at a time, runs the matching test(s), reports
// whether the mutation was caught (a test failed), then restores the file.
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const { execSync } = require("child_process");

const repo = process.argv[2];
const TEST = "packages/excalidraw/tests/collaboratorVisibility.test.tsx";

const mutations = [
  {
    name: "JSON save filter",
    file: "packages/excalidraw/actions/actionExport.tsx",
    from: "const elements = getLocallyVisibleElements(allElements, appState);",
    to: "const elements = allElements;",
    test: "JSON save",
  },
  {
    name: "search filter",
    file: "packages/excalidraw/components/SearchMenu.tsx",
    from: "const elements = getLocallyVisibleElements(\n      app.scene.getNonDeletedElements(),",
    to: "const elements = ((x: any) => x)(\n      app.scene.getNonDeletedElements(),",
    test: "never finds hidden",
  },
  {
    name: "embeds filter",
    file: "packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx",
    from: "isIframeElement(el)) &&\n          !isElementHiddenLocally(el, elementsMap, this.state),",
    to: "isIframeElement(el)) &&\n          true,",
    test: "hides embeds",
  },
  {
    name: "text container filter",
    file: "packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx",
    from: "elements[index].isDeleted ||\n        isElementHiddenLocally(",
    to: "elements[index].isDeleted ||\n        false && isElementHiddenLocally(",
    test: "never binds new text",
  },
  {
    name: "frame drop filter",
    file: "packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx",
    from: "!isElementHiddenLocally(frame, elementsMap, this.state) &&",
    to: "",
    test: "never joins a hidden frame",
  },
  {
    name: "motion path target filter",
    file: "packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx",
    from: "isFrameLikeElement(candidate) ||\n        isElementHiddenLocally(candidate, elementsMap, this.state)",
    to: "isFrameLikeElement(candidate)",
    test: "never picks a hidden shape",
  },
  {
    name: "binding hover filter (getBindableElements)",
    file: "packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx",
    from: "return getLocallyVisibleElements(\n      this.scene.getNonDeletedElements(),",
    to: "return ((x: any) => x)(\n      this.scene.getNonDeletedElements(),",
    test: "never suggests binding",
  },
  {
    name: "focus point filter",
    file: "packages/element/src/arrows/focus.ts",
    from: "excludeElementsByHiddenCreators(\n      scene.getNonDeletedElements(),",
    to: "((x: any, ..._: any[]) => x)(\n      scene.getNonDeletedElements(),",
    test: "never moves the binding",
  },
];

for (const m of mutations) {
  const file = path.join(repo, m.file);
  const original = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  if (!original.includes(m.from)) {
    console.log(`?? ${m.name}: pattern not found`);
    continue;
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(file, original.replace(m.from, m.to));
  let caught = false;
  try {
    execSync(`npx vitest run ${TEST} -t "${m.test}"`, {
      cwd: repo,
      stdio: "pipe",
    });
  } catch {
    caught = true;
  } finally {
    fs.writeFileSync(file, original);
  }
  console.log(`${caught ? "CAUGHT  " : "MISSED  "} ${m.name}`);
}

describe("acquireClientId when storage or Web Locks misbehave", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    sessionStorage.clear();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it("treats a malformed pool as empty", async () => {
    localStorage.setItem(
      STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_CLIENT_IDS,
      JSON.stringify({ not: "an array" }),
    );

    const id = await acquireClientId(createBrowser().openTab().locks);

    expect(
      JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_CLIENT_IDS)!),
    ).toEqual([id]);
  });

  it("adds this tab's (sessionStorage) id back to the pool if it's missing", async () => {
    sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SESSION_STORAGE_CLIENT_ID, "orphan");

    expect(await acquireClientId(createBrowser().openTab().locks)).toBe(
      "orphan",
    );
    expect(
      JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_CLIENT_IDS)!),
    ).toEqual(["orphan"]);
  });

  it("still gets an id when storage is unavailable (private mode, quota…)", async () => {
    vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype, "getItem").mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error("storage unavailable");
    });
    vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype, "setItem").mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error("storage unavailable");
    });

    const id = await acquireClientId(createBrowser().openTab().locks);

    expect(typeof id).toBe("string");
    expect(id).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("falls back to sessionStorage when Web Locks fail", async () => {
    const consoleError = vi
      .spyOn(console, "error")
      .mockImplementation(() => {});
    const brokenLocks = {
      request: () => Promise.reject(new Error("locks broken")),
    } as unknown as LockManager;

    const id = await acquireClientId(brokenLocks);

    expect(id).toBeTruthy();
    expect(sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SESSION_STORAGE_CLIENT_ID)).toBe(
      id,
    );
    expect(consoleError).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

  });
});

## 1. High: collaboration, through the real Collab and Portal ([collabVisibility.test.tsx](excalidraw-app/tests/collabVisibility.test.tsx))

### The harness

```ts
vi.mock("socket.io-client", () => ({ default: () => ({
  id: "my-socket",
  on: (event, handler) => { mocks.handlers.set(event, handler) },   // capture server events
  emit: (...args) => { mocks.emitted.push(args) },                  // record what we send
  once() {}, off() {}, close() {},
})}));
// encryption = passthrough, so sent/received messages are plain JSON
vi.mock("@excalidraw/excalidraw/data/encryption", () => ({ ..., encryptData: async (_k, data) => ({ encryptedBuffer: data, iv }), decryptData: async (_iv, data) => data }));
vi.mock("../data/firebase", () => ({ loadFromFirebase: async () => mocks.storedRoomElements, ... }));

const deliver = (message) => mocks.handlers.get("client-broadcast")(encode(message), iv); // a peer's message arrives
const sync = () => window.collab.syncElements(h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted()); // what onChange does
const startNewRoom = async () => { await startCollaboration(); await triggerServerEvent("first-in-room"); ... };
```

Getting the harness working took three fixes, and **none of them were bugs in the feature**:

- **Encryption mock:** the `importOriginal` mock style deadlocked the app's module loading, so I mock all six exports explicitly.
- **Async `act`:** wrapping server events in async `act` waited on the room's 5-second fallback timer.
- **My helper returned a promise:** returning the scene promise from an async helper made callers wait for a scene that only arrives later.

### Identity (8 tests)

| Test | Proves |
| --- | --- |
| `announces its identity once the room is initialized` | Nothing is sent beforehand. Afterwards, every `USER_IDENTITY` carries `socketId: "my-socket"` and this tab's `clientId`. It's announced again once the random username is chosen |
| `introduces itself to newcomers (new-user)` | When someone joins, we send **exactly** `[SCENE_INIT, USER_IDENTITY]`. This is the fix for names only appearing after the mouse moves |
| `re-announces itself when renaming` | `setUsername("Renamed")` sends one identity message with the new name and updates our own directory entry |
| `sends its client id with pointer and idle updates` | Both volatile messages carry our `clientId` |
| `learns peers' ids from USER_IDENTITY, pointer and idle messages` | Three peers, one per message type, get `Collaborator.id` set, and Alice lands in the directory. **A repeated sighting within a minute leaves the directory object identical** (`toBe`), so there's no write on every message |
| `(control) clients without collaborator visibility send no id` | An older client's pointer **and** idle messages are accepted (its name is known) and get no `id`. This protects compatibility |
| `marks its own collaborator entry with its client id` | After `room-user-change`, our entry has `isCurrentUser: true` and `id = clientId`. The "(you)" label and the view-mode lock depend on this |
| `refreshes when it last saw a collaborator who left` | Using a mocked `Date.now`: Alice is seen at T, leaves at T+5 minutes, and her `lastSeen` becomes T+5 minutes. `Date.now` is restored before `waitFor`, which needs a real clock |

### Ownership (4 tests, all confirmed to fail when the code is broken)

```ts
it("an echo of our own element doesn't make it remote", async () => {
  await startCollaboration(); // room not initialized yet
  /* draw "early" */ sync();
  expect(getCreatorId("early")).toBeUndefined(); // not stamped yet (gated)
  await deliver({
    type: UPDATE,
    payload: { elements: h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted() },
  }); // echo
  await triggerServerEvent("first-in-room");
  sync();
  expect(getCreatorId("early")).toBe(getClientId()); // still ours
});
```

| Test | Proves | Caught when I broke… |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stamps new local elements during sync, never peers' elements` | After a peer's UPDATE: my new shape gets **my** ID, Alice's shape keeps `alice`, and the legacy shape stays unstamped | The stamp rule (ignoring remote IDs) |
| `editing a peer's element doesn't transfer ownership` | Moving Alice's shape and syncing leaves it as `alice` | Same |
| `an echo of our own element doesn't make it remote` | Above | `_reconcileElements` marking everything remote |
| `joining a room never stamps the room's stored elements` | Joins with a stored Firebase scene and applies it as the app does. Nothing gets restamped, and the directory is re-published after the join's reset | `initializeRoom` not marking the stored scene |

## 3. Low: edge cases and storage failures

| Test | File | Proves |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggling without a bucket id does nothing` | collaboratorVisibility | The hidden set is unchanged |
| `show all is only offered while something is hidden` | collaboratorVisibility | The predicate is false, then true |
| `the selection safety net also clears a hidden linear element editor` | collaboratorVisibility | `selectedLinearElement` on Bob's arrow becomes `null` |
| `menu rows fall back to the directory name; no directory → no previously seen` | collaboratorVisibility | Covers the row builder's fallback branches |
| `export without a hidden set keeps every element (other callers)` | collaboratorVisibility | Callers that don't pass a hidden set keep the old behaviour |
| `treats a malformed pool as empty` | clientIdentity | `{not:"an array"}` in storage becomes a fresh pool `[id]` |
| `adds this tab's (sessionStorage) id back to the pool if it's missing` | clientIdentity | The `orphan` ID is reclaimed and written back to the pool |
| `still gets an id when storage is unavailable` | clientIdentity | Both storages throw, and an ID is still returned |
| `falls back to sessionStorage when Web Locks fail` | clientIdentity | `locks.request` rejects, an ID is still returned and stored in the session, and the error is logged |
| `ignores storage that isn't an object of rooms` | collaboratorDirectory | An array in storage gives an empty directory |
| `doesn't throw when storage is unavailable` | collaboratorDirectory | `setItem` throws, and saving doesn't |
| `prunes rooms without a timestamp first` | collaboratorDirectory | With 20 rooms already stored (one without `updated`), the timestamp-less room is the one dropped, and the current room is kept |

**The two tests I fixed after the coverage check:** both "storage unavailable" tests spied on `Storage.prototype`. In this repo's test setup, `localStorage` is a **plain object** (only `sessionStorage` is a real `Storage`), so `localStorage` never threw and the tests passed without testing anything. They now spy on `localStorage` directly, and they **assert the spy was actually called**, so this can't silently happen again.

feat(collab): local collaborator drawing visibility controls

Let each client show/hide collaborators' drawings (individually, show all,
hide all) without touching shared scene data, sync or other clients' views
(subissue of #14).

Ownership & identity (excalidraw-app)
- one-time `customData.creatorId` stamp by the client that first introduces
  an element to the room; edits never transfer ownership, pastes/duplicates
  belong to the paster

- AppState: hiddenCollaboratorIds, collaboratorDirectory,
  viewModeBeforeSelfHide (never persisted, exported or synced)
- single visibility rule (element/ownership.ts) used by rendering,
  hit-testing, selection/binding chokepoints, eraser, search and exports
- hidden elements can't be selected, erased, bound to or exported;
  existing bindings are kept; never-seen creators share the miscellaneous
  bucket with untagged elements
- toggle / show all / hide all actions; hiding your own drawings locks view
  mode with an explanatory banner
- collaborator visibility menu next to the avatars (desktop + phone)

Tests: 129 feature tests incl. multi-client collaboration flows through the
real Collab/Portal, with control cases and mutation checks.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
